As the federal government, we are doing, and will continue to do, everything in our power to protect Jewish life in our country and around the world.
In doing so, we stand unwaveringly by Israel's side.
The fact that there is a country, a state in the world where Jews are not a vulnerable minority, where they can find protection when barbarism once again prevails in their home countries, is also part of our historical responsibility.

Germany's Chancellor Merz:
Historical responsibility means speaking out against antisemitism and confronting it wherever it appears.
It means taking an interest in Israel's fate.

Germany's Chancellor Merz:
As a German, I am infinitely grateful that Jews, after the Shoah, have once again, so to speak, pitched their tents here in our country and here in Munich.
That communities have emerged here, kindergartens, retirement homes, restaurants, and that synagogues have been built, and are still being built or restored.
